sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Newgrange Passage Tomb was built in 3500 BC, making it older than Stonehenge and the Pyramids. [S1E13]

Scarlet Byrne theorized that the Irish Seeker Cú Chulainn had to defeat a water Titan or clear a water trap in order to find the amulet of Gybolg. He eventually sealed the amulet within an obelisk in the secret chamber. [S1E13]

Years later, Scarlet and Dante's team travelled to Newgrange Passage Tomb to investigate. After locating the secret chamber's entrance, Sophie Casterwill managed to open it with Breakspell, albeit for a short amount of time due to the immense power of the Seeker who sealed it. Scarlett then discovered and bonded with Gybolg, then summoned it to fight alongside Dante's team against Klaus' Suits and defeat one of their Bonelasher Titans. [Home Turf]

full_text:
The Newgrange Passage Tomb is located in Ireland and is one of the oldest burial mounds in the worlds. It served as the resting place for the Titan Gybolg.

==Layout==
The main mortuary chamber has stairs leading down to an enchanted door, behind which the secret chamber with the obelisk of Cú Chulainn is.

==History==
The Newgrange Passage Tomb was built in 3500 BC, making it older than Stonehenge and the Pyramids. [S1E13]

Scarlet Byrne theorized that the Irish Seeker Cú Chulainn had to defeat a water Titan or clear a water trap in order to find the amulet of Gybolg. He eventually sealed the amulet within an obelisk in the secret chamber. [S1E13]

Years later, Scarlet and Dante's team travelled to Newgrange Passage Tomb to investigate. After locating the secret chamber's entrance, Sophie Casterwill managed to open it with Breakspell, albeit for a short amount of time due to the immense power of the Seeker who sealed it. Scarlett then discovered and bonded with Gybolg, then summoned it to fight alongside Dante's team against Klaus' Suits and defeat one of their Bonelasher Titans. [Home Turf]
